full_prompt_en: A square atmospheric landscape painting looks over a quiet blue-green inlet from a slightly raised, grassy bank. The foreground is a loose tangle of thin reeds, dark shrubs, pale stones, and a few white bird-like forms beside a patch of ochre-yellow growth. A slender tree trunk rises at the left, its sparse canopy dissolving into the sky. The water begins just beyond this rough bank and curves toward a more densely wooded shore on the right. Two tiny boats sit near the center-left water, one carrying a dark upright shape that may be a person or a narrow mast. A small pale building stands on the right shore among dark foliage, with a light path or strip of ground leading to the water. Fine, tall trees rise behind it, their trunks visible through mist. Farther back, water, shore, and sky merge in layers of smoky blue and gray. A bright cloudy opening near the upper center sends a pale reflection down toward the middle of the inlet. Small dark marks cross the sky, suggesting distant birds. The scene is not drawn with crisp contours: foreground plants are made of quick strokes and scratches, and distant trees are softly rubbed into the haze. Blue, teal, gray, and muted olive dominate, interrupted by the small white building, pale birds, and ochre grass. The composition is spacious above and denser below, with the left trunk and right tree group framing the water. Light appears diffuse and filtered by cloud, so there are no hard cast shadows. No readable text appears. The image conveys a hushed, slightly dreamlike waterside atmosphere through thin paint, mist, and small human-scale details.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、富于空气感的风景画从略高的草岸望过安静的蓝绿色水湾。前景是细芦苇、深色灌木、浅石和几团白色似鸟形体的松散纠结，旁边有一片赭黄植被。细树干从左边升起，稀疏树冠溶进天空。水面从这片粗糙岸边开始，向右侧更密的树林岸线弯去。两只小船停在中左水面，其中一只上有深色竖形，可能是人或窄桅杆。右岸一座浅色小屋立在深叶丛里，浅色小径或地带从它通向水边。后面几株纤细高树升起，树干透过雾可见。更远处，水、岸与天空在烟蓝和灰色层次中合并。上方中央附近有明亮云口，向水湾中间投下一道浅色倒光。几个深色小痕迹穿过天空，像远鸟。场景没有锐利轮廓：前景植物由快速笔触和刮痕构成，远树柔软地擦入雾里。蓝、蓝绿、灰与低饱和橄榄色占主导，小白屋、浅鸟和赭黄草地形成中断。构图上方宽敞、下方较密，左树干与右树群为水面作框。光似穿过云层漫散下来，因此没有硬投影。没有可读文字。画面以薄颜料、雾气和细小的人类尺度细节营造安静、略似梦境的水边气氛。
style_prompt_en: Atmospheric painting builds a watery scene from thin blue-green washes, smoky gray haze, and quick dark botanical marks. Distant forms dissolve into the sky, while the near ground retains scratched reeds, broken brushwork, and small pale accents. A bright cloud opening diffuses light across a low horizontal field, creating a soft reflected path rather than sharp highlights. Sparse tall verticals frame a broad center, and tiny dark details provide scale without dominating the landscape. Muted olive and ochre interrupt the cool blue palette at the lower edge. The surface feels layered, lightly rubbed, and imperfect, with a quiet dreamlike depth rather than hard contour precision.
style_prompt_zh: 富于空气感的绘画以薄薄蓝绿水彩般色层、烟灰雾气和快速深色植物笔痕搭建水景。远处形体溶入天空，近地则保留刮擦芦苇、断续刷痕和细小浅色重点。明亮云口把光漫散在低处水平场域上，形成柔软的反射通道，而非锐利高光。稀疏高竖形框住宽阔中心，微小深色细节提供尺度却不支配风景。低处边缘的低饱和橄榄与赭黄打断冷蓝配色。表面层叠、略有擦拭感且不完全规整，有安静如梦的深度，而非硬轮廓精度。
theme_en: A misty blue inlet with tiny boats and a small pale shore building
theme_zh: 雾蓝色水湾里有小船和岸边浅色小屋
name: Arthur Boyd
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
